Theme 008 · Product UI as the stage

Calendar Timeline Scrub

The work week drawn as an editing timeline: a day ruler, a team lane, a customers lane and a playhead that scrubs with the music. Acme Pulse is a new lane of tiny ticks underneath everything — the invisible background work made visible — and the counterfactual Friday incident fades out once the Tuesday catch lands.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Day / minute ruler — the timeline header; zooms from week to minutes.
  • Playhead + time pill — amber “now” line that scrubs with the music.
  • Event blocks — team work (deploy #2231, Roll back · 09:48) as clips.
  • Pulse lane — a teal lane of per-minute ticks: the background work made visible.
  • Ghost event — striped coral “Tickets ×23” on Friday: the counterfactual.
  • Duration bracket — “found 3 days late” vs “resolved in 6 min”.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Speed-ramped scrub — the playhead eases fast/slow along a custom curve with a directional blur ramp; every stop is on a downbeat (2 s per bar at 120 BPM).
  • Block growth — event blocks scaleX from the left edge, 0.3 s back.out(1.4), each on a kick.
  • Ghost dissolve — the Friday event desaturates and fades to 35 % over 1 s as the Tuesday catch lands; Pulse ticks march on 1/16 notes throughout.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Why: the counterfactual (Friday tickets) against the actual (a Tuesday catch) is the clearest possible proof of “before customers noticed”, and ticks in their own lane make invisible background work concrete. Risk: the before/after logic must read instantly — label the ghost and the brackets boldly and keep only three lanes.

Adapt to your product: put your users' real week on the ruler, your product's activity in its own lane, and show the bad event your product prevents as a ghost that fades.
